_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md, 'Subagents are full agents', under plan-and-execute. A clearly-Deliberate top-level task -> PlanWorkflow -> planning turn proposes ONE checkpoint. The checkpoint turn (<turn:1>:cp:1) spawns a subagent handed a clearly-complex sub-task. The subagent runs ClassifyRequest + RoutingWorkflow itself and, being Deliberate, opens its OWN single-turn task-run (turns.plan_id == its own turn_id <turn:1>:cp:1:sub:1, openedFresh in turn.go) — one reason-act loop, no nested planning/checkpoint turns. At the subagent turn's end dispatchRecordSkill fires over its trajectory. None of classify / routing / RecordSkill happened for subagents before the ParentType=='session' gate was removed.

message.content: Have a subagent run a full security audit of the auth module while the main line handles the API cleanup, then reconcile the two before we ship.

scripted_model_responses.content: Plan: delegate the audit, do the cleanup, reconcile.

checkpoints.intent: Delegate the auth-module security audit to a subagent and fold its findings into the cleanup
checkpoints.done_when: the subagent has delivered a prioritized findings report and the critical items are captured

arguments.prompt: Do a thorough security audit of the authentication module: check for injection, broken authentication and session handling, secrets committed in code, and missing rate limiting on the login path. Produce a prioritized findings report with severity for each issue.

scripted_model_responses.content: Audit complete — 3 findings: 1 critical (no login rate limit), 2 medium. Prioritized report attached.

checkpoint_responses.content: The subagent found a critical rate-limit gap on login; folded into the cleanup. Checkpoint done.

arguments.note: critical: no rate limiting on the login path
